tour.step1Desc: Choose the USV that will run the mission. Green dot = online, red = offline.
tour.step2Desc: Click "New Mission" to create a new mission. A vehicle must be selected first.
tour.step3Desc: Load a previously saved mission to edit or resend to the vehicle.
tour.step4Desc: Displays the name, status, and waypoint count of the currently active mission.
tour.step5Desc: The USV start and return point. Click the home icon on the map to set it.
tour.step6Desc: All route points appear here. Click the map to add waypoints, or use Zone mode for auto coverage.
tour.step7Desc: Path: add waypoints one by one. Zone: draw an area and the system generates coverage path automatically.
tour.step8Desc: Estimated distance, time, and battery usage calculated in real-time as waypoints are added.
tour.step9Desc: Save all waypoints to the server. Must be done before sending the mission to the vehicle.
tour.step10Desc: Upload the mission to the USV via MQTT. Vehicle must be online and mission must be saved first.

banner.description: SEANO enables real-time ocean monitoring and autonomous missions across Indonesian waters — supporting research, security, and national resilience.

feature.heading: Unleashing SEANO's Intelligence Through Advanced Features
feature.description: SEANO is an autonomous surface vehicle platform designed for precision ocean observation and intelligent marine surveys. Equipped with advanced navigation, multi-sensor payloads, and real-time communication, SEANO transforms how marine data is collected, monitored, and controlled.
feature.feature1Desc: SEANO performs fully autonomous marine missions with intelligent waypoint navigation, obstacle avoidance, and remote operational control for precise and efficient ocean surveys.
feature.feature2Desc: Live telemetry powered by MQTT & WebSocket delivers instant sensor data visualization and direct vehicle control through an integrated web dashboard.
feature.feature3Desc: Advanced oceanographic sensors including CTD, ADCP, GPS, IMU, and meteorological modules provide accurate, high-resolution marine data for research and analysis.
